Close; for each expression [CDbl('1,5') ;; CDbl('1.5') ;; CCur('1,5') ;; CDate('3/4/2020') ;; CDate('2020/03/04') ;; CStr(1.5) ;; CStr(#2020-03-04 13:30#) ;; CBool('Wahr') ;; '1,5' + 0 ;; Format(1.5) ;; Val('1,5')]: SELECT e FROM L WHERE ID = 1 as a snapshot, read; then SELECT ID, D, C, T, B, S FROM L ORDER BY ID read to EOF.
